title: Understanding, Reading, Writing
label: ch:ar-understanding-reading-writing
canDo: I can say the Arabic for 'he understood', 'he read', 'he asked' and 'he wrote', and build a whole family of nouns off each root using the doer, done-to and ma- place shapes I already know.

payoff.summary: Run ك-ت-ب through every pattern the track has taught — kitāb, kātib, maktūb, maktab, maktaba — naming the earlier word that wears each shape (qāʾil and qāriʾ for the doer, maqūl and mafhūm and maqrūʾ for the done-to, madhhab and masʾala for the ma- place), then place the root beside Hebrew katav and English ketubah.
